title: Anthropic上市文件披露多重风险
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: They had a great line in the S1.
segments.zh: 他们在S1文件里有一句话很精彩。

segments.en: They described the cloud providers as, quote, investors, customers, distribution partners, and competitors all at once.
segments.zh: 他们这样描述云服务商：市场参与者、客户、分销伙伴和竞争对手，集于一身。

segments.en: Obviously, Google and Microsoft and SpaceX are all competing with them in the AI space
segments.zh: 显然，谷歌、微软和SpaceX在AI领域都与他们竞争，

segments.en: while, at the same time, providing them this computing power they need.
segments.zh: 同时，又为他们提供所需的算力。

segments.en: So partners and competitors sounds messy-fast. It's very much so.
segments.zh: 所以伙伴和竞争对手听起来很乱。确实如此。

segments.en: And investors as well, in many cases, if you've seen those circular financing diagrams, this is exactly this.
segments.zh: 很多情况下他们也是市场参与者，如果你看过那些循环融资图，正是如此。

segments.en: OK, speaking of risks, usually the risks in an S1 are like, you could face new competition from similar business or there could be new regulatory changes that make our product harder to get.
segments.zh: 好，说到风险，通常S1文件里的风险是：可能面临类似业务的新竞争，或者监管变化使产品更难获得。

segments.en: Or I was reading Jersey Mike's S1 filing from earlier this year.
segments.zh: 或者我今年早些时候读的Jersey Mike's的S1文件。

segments.en: It's like food safety risks. But in Therophics, risk perspective was 94 pages long.
segments.zh: 比如食品安全风险。但在Therophics，风险部分长达94页。

segments.en: And included some risks I have never seen in an S1.
segments.zh: 还包括一些我在S1文件中从未见过的风险。

segments.en: What stood out to you about the company's risk assessment?
segments.zh: 公司风险评估中什么最突出？

segments.en: The novel's worth of risks. And the breadth of it is fascinating.
segments.zh: 风险多如小说，广度引人入胜。

segments.en: I mean, like you say, tech companies that often come out and they'll say, well, maybe the EU will go crazy and regulate us to death or something like that.
segments.zh: 就像你说的，科技公司常会说，欧盟可能疯狂监管到死之类的。

segments.en: This is a company that has sort of threats from all sides.
segments.zh: 这家公司面临各方威胁。

segments.en: It could be from the US government, which has tried to designate them as a risk.
segments.zh: 可能来自美国政府，它曾试图将其列为风险。
